protocol: Custom stratified source-grouped outer folds with the preceding fold used for validation and remaining folds for training. Training-only normalization; validation-selected checkpoints and thresholds. Existing videos have been inspected previously: exploratory repeated evaluation, not a fresh untouched test or reproduction of the dataset's supplied five-fold protocol. Filename grouping does not replace full-video source/label review. Linear controls use training-only scaling and fitting; validation log loss selects motion regularization and validation macro-F1 selects thresholds. Each deterministic control is fitted once per fold, not repeated per TCN seed.
limitations: Aggregate detection counts and quality can encode scene, crowd density and pose-estimator behavior. This is a confound diagnostic, not a skeleton-motion classifier.
